newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-RAVANELLI AND VIERI FACE FITNESS FIGHT.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-RAVANELLI AND VIERI FACE FITNESS FIGHT.

text.p: Strikers Fabrizio Ravanelli and Christian Vieri both face a struggle to be fit for Italy's World Cup qualifiers against Moldova and Poland.
Vieri and Ravanelli arrived at the Italian training camp at Coverciano near Florence on Monday with niggling injuries.
Juventus striker Vieri hurt his ankle during Sunday's 0-0 away draw with Napoli, while Ravanelli has muscular problems following recent games for his English premiership side Middlesbrough.
Italy play Moldova in Trieste on Saturday and then travel to Chorzow to face Poland on April 2.
Italian coach Cesare Maldini is likely to be more concerned by the condition of the 16-times capped Ravanelli than by that of the uncapped Vieri.
Given the injury-enforced absence of Pier Luigi Casiraghi, Ravanelli looks like a probable first choice to partner Chelsea's Gianfranco Zola in both group two qualifiers.
Maldini has however given himself plenty of options in attack since he has also named Enrico Chiesa, Filippo Inzaghi and Michele Padovano in his squad.
Following their 1-0 win against England at Wembley last month, Italy are joint top of group two with England on nine points but with a game in hand.
